package.description: The Philippines Unicode Keyboard Layout (PH-UKL) is the first Unicode keyboard layout for Philippine languages with ₱eso and Baybayin (ᜊᜌ᜔ᜊᜌᜒᜈ᜔) support.

en-US.description: The Philippines Unicode Keyboard Layout (PH-UKL) is the first Unicode keyboard layout for Philippine languages with ₱eso and Baybayin (ᜊᜌ᜔ᜊᜌᜒᜈ᜔) support.
en-US.longDescription: The Philippines Unicode Keyboard Layout (PH-UKL) is the first Unicode-based keyboard layout made for the needs of the Filipino people. Its main features are the availability of the Philippine Peso currency symbol, the letter Ññ, as well as, the Philippine diacritical marks.
en-US.name: Buhid Baybayin (QWERTY)
